sections.title: Your home
sections.help: Answer what you know. Approximate dates are fine. Leave anything blank or write unsure. Your answers do not replace the Seller's Disclosure Notice.

sections.title: Documents to gather
sections.help: Phone photos and screenshots are fine. Having a document does not upload it. Add files separately. If you cannot find something, choose Can't locate.

groups.title: Generator, pool or other service contracts
Solar lease, PPA or finance agreement

fields.label: Approximate annual MUD/PID tax or assessment
Propane tank size in gallons and supplier
Internet options available at the address, fiber, cable, etc.
Do you have a security system?
Is the system owned or leased?
Which equipment stays or goes: panels, cameras, doorbell, sensors, smart locks

sections.title: Showings
sections.help: These answers are for your agent. Share alarm codes directly by phone or text rather than writing them here.

fields.label: Do you need advance notice before showings?
Will an alarm be set during showings?
Do showing agents need an alarm code?
Where will they be during showings?
Will pets be home during showings?
Anything else we need to know for showings? Gate codes, parking, livestock, areas off limits, work-from-home hours.

sections.title: What stays and what goes
sections.help: Items permanently attached generally stay unless excluded. This list helps us plan; final terms are set in the sales contract.

sections.title: Systems and appliances
sections.help: Use the year installed or replaced rather than an age. Approximate dates and unsure are fine.

sections.title: Upgrades and improvements
sections.help: Be specific about brand, material, size and scope. Costs are optional and go only to the appraiser. For added rooms or converted space, describe heating/cooling and permits; do not estimate square footage.

fields.label: Anything an appraiser or buyer would probably miss? Hidden upgrades, behind-the-wall work, quality of materials.

sections.title: Recent maintenance and service
sections.help: Include anything from the last few years.

fields.label: Year insulation added / R-value, if known

groups.title: Water softener, EV charging and technology

fields.label: Smart thermostats, lighting, whole-home Wi-Fi, other technology that stays

sections.title: Flood, insurance and survey
sections.help: Premiums are optional. Past flooding, water penetration and insurance claims belong on your Seller's Disclosure Notice.

fields.label: Any wind/hail or roof insurance discounts?
Do you have a survey of the property?
Have you signed a T-47 before?
Anything added or changed since the survey?
If yes, what and when? Fence, pool, garage, carport, shop, shed, addition, driveway, patio cover, slab, etc.

sections.title: Living here
sections.help: Keep it about the home and property. Leave out descriptions of neighbors or who lives in the area.

fields.label: What do you love most about this home?
Best features a buyer might miss on a 20-minute showing, storage, pantry, natural light, views, etc.
Anything else you want the appraiser or buyers to know?

acknowledgment: My answers are based on my best knowledge and have not been verified by Origen Realty. They are not a warranty and do not replace the Seller's Disclosure Notice, inspections or the sales contract. I allow my agent to prepare a Property Brief and Home Guide from my answers and documents and review both with me before sharing with appraisers, lenders, buyers and their agents.
